import statistics

with open("data.txt") as f:
    nums = [float(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

with open("stats.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"count: {len(nums)}\n")
    f.write(f"mean: {statistics.mean(nums)}\n")
    f.write(f"median: {statistics.median(nums)}\n")
